title: Java Angular Full Stack Development Lead - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The **Full Stack Development Lead Analyst (Digital Software Engineering Lead)** is a senior technical and people leadership professional who drives end\-to\-end engineering excellence, architecture, and delivery across web, mobile, API, microservices, and AI\-enabled digital ecosystems. This role acts as a recognized technical authority and managerial leader, steering application development strategy with deep hands\-on expertise in **Java**, **Angular**, **Microservices architectures**, **REST/GraphQL APIs**, **Mobile/Web platforms**, and **modern AI engineering tools \& GenAI integrations**.


The role combines strategic direction, architectural governance (Next Gen Architecture / NGA), hands\-on technical mentoring, and engineering team leadership. The Lead Manager guides cross\-functional engineering teams, promotes the adoption of AI\-assisted software development practices (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, and GenAI gateway/model integrations), collaborates closely with Product Managers, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and Enterprise Architects, and influences stakeholders across lines of business (LOBs) to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient digital solutions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

**1\. Technical Leadership \& Full Stack Engineering Delivery**


* **End\-to\-End Full Stack Ownership:** Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of mission\-critical, enterprise\-grade web and mobile applications powered by modern Java microservices backends and Angular frontends.
* **Architecture \& Modernization:** Drive adoption of Next Gen Architecture (NGA) and Plan of Record (POR) standards across microservices, distributed caching, event\-driven systems (Kafka/MQ), and cloud\-native container platforms.
* **API Strategy \& Integration:** Architect robust, secure, and scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ensuring adherence to enterprise API lifecycle standards, versioning, security protocols (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS), and API gateway patterns.
* **Web \& Mobile Development Leadership:** Guide teams in building high\-performance, responsive web applications in Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx/State Management) and modern mobile experiences (native/hybrid/responsive mobile frameworks), ensuring seamless cross\-platform performance and accessibility (WCAG).
* **Delivery Management:** Serve as development lead and engineering manager for multiple concurrent large\-scale digital initiatives, establishing clear delivery roadmaps, managing technical debt, and resolving complex cross\-team dependencies across Agile and hybrid delivery models.

**2\. AI\-Assisted Engineering \& Innovation**


* **AI Tooling \& SDLC Productivity:** Champion and drive team adoption of generative AI developer tools and AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AI code review and test generation tools) to enhance developer productivity, code quality, and time\-to\-market.
* **GenAI \& LLM Integration:** Guide architectural patterns for integrating GenAI capabilities, LLM endpoints, semantic search/vector retrieval, AI gateways, and prompt\-driven microservices into enterprise web and mobile applications.
* **AI Governance \& Quality Gates:** Ensure that AI\-generated code, prompt structures, and GenAI integrations adhere to firm\-wide security, privacy, guardrails, compliance, and IP protection standards.

**3\. Architecture Governance, Design \& Code Reviews**


* **Design Review Board \& Patterns:** Act as a core member of the Design Review Board to evaluate system architectures, establish generic reusable design patterns, and enforce enterprise CTO guidelines across digital domains.
* **Code \& Quality Governance:** Champion rigorous code reviews for Java microservices, Angular applications, mobile modules, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high code quality, security posture (SAST/DAST/OSS scanning), performance benchmarking, and test coverage.
* **Metrics \& Observability:** Establish and track clear engineering metrics covering code review thoroughness, CI/CD deployment velocity, test automation coverage, production defect leakage, AI tool adoption gains, and design pattern adoption.
* **Resource \& Performance Optimization:** Direct engineering teams in designing systems optimized for runtime performance, memory footprints, thread management, database query efficiency, low\-latency API response times, and high\-concurrency workloads.

**4\. Team Management, Coaching \& Stakeholder Alignment**


* **People Leadership \& Mentorship:** Lead, coach, and empower Software Development Engineers (SDEs), tech leads, and full stack teams, fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning, engineering craftsmanship, and innovation.
* **Stakeholder \& Risk Management:** Partner with business owners, TPMs, and Product Managers to assess technical and schedule risks, evaluate trade\-offs between delivery timelines and architectural runway, and communicate complex risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
* **Issue \& Blocker Resolution:** Proactively anticipate bottlenecks, drive escalation management, mitigate multi\-level delivery risks, and facilitate constructive technical dialogues to resolve discordant viewpoints.

**5\. Governance, Risk \& Controls**


* **Risk \& Compliance Safeguarding:** Appropriately assess risk in all technical and architectural decisions, safeguarding the firm’s assets, client data, and reputation.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure strict adherence to information security standards, data privacy laws, regulatory mandates, cryptographic standards, AI usage policies, and secure SDLC controls, escalating and reporting issues with complete transparency.
  

  

**Qualifications \& Skills**

  

  

**Experience \& Education**

  

  

* **Experience:** 10–12\+ years of progressive software development experience with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership / engineering management role driving full stack, microservices, and mobile/web development.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  

  

**Core Technical Competencies**

  

  

* **Backend \& Microservices:**
	+ Deep expertise in **Java (Java 17/21\)**, **Spring Boot**, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, CQRS, Event Sourcing).
	+ Solid background in distributed messaging systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ).
	+ Experience with SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, schema design, and query optimization.
* **Frontend \& Web Development:**
	+ Advanced proficiency in **Angular (v14\+)**, **TypeScript**, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, SCSS/CSS3, and state management (NgRx/RxJS).
	+ Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools, micro\-frontends architecture, web performance tuning, and cross\-browser/responsive UI design.
* **API \& Integration:**
	+ Proven track record designing and securing RESTful APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL, and integration with API Gateways.
* **Mobile Development Experience:**
	+ Solid understanding of mobile application architecture (iOS/Android native integration, hybrid frameworks, responsive web/PWA), mobile security best practices, and mobile API orchestration (BFF patterns).
* **AI Tools \& GenAI Integration (Preferred / Desired):**
	+ Practical exposure to **AI\-assisted development tools** (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants, automated unit test generators, AI code review tools).
	+ Familiarity with integrating **GenAI APIs/LLM endpoints**, AI gateways, prompt engineering patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, or intelligent chat/search capabilities into enterprise applications.
	+ Awareness of AI governance, data privacy, and security guardrails for enterprise AI usage.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:**
	+ Experience deploying containerized workloads on Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift / Docker and public/private cloud environments (AWS, Cloud Foundry, Akamai).
	+ Proficiency in CI/CD pipeline automation (Tekton, Jenkins, Harness, GitLab CI), automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Selenium), and static code analysis (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  

**Leadership \& Soft Skills**

  

  

* Proven track record of guiding cross\-functional teams without direct authority in matrixed enterprise environments.
* Strong negotiation, diplomacy, and executive presentation skills to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business partners.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to define technical roadmaps while remaining capable of deep\-diving into architecture and code.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is building world\-class software for customer onboarding, professional services, and modern service delivery teams.


We care deeply about product craft. Our engineers work closely with Product and Design to solve complex problems, build delightful user experiences, and create systems that remain fast and reliable as we scale.


If you enjoy owning a problem end\-to\-end — from the database and APIs all the way to the interactions a customer sees in the browser — this role is for you.


**What will you do?**
---------------------


As a **Lead Full Stack Engineer**, you will own meaningful parts of the Rocketlane product from design through production.


You will:


* Design and build features end\-to\-end across our **React frontend and Java backend**.
* Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, thoughtful product experiences.
* Build polished, performant user experiences for complex SaaS workflows.
* Design clean APIs, data models, and backend services that can scale as our customers and usage grow.
* Solve challenging product problems involving real\-time collaboration, rich interactive experiences, workflow automation, large datasets, and highly configurable enterprise use cases.
* Make thoughtful architectural decisions across frontend, backend, database, caching, and asynchronous processing.
* Own the performance and reliability of what you build — from browser performance through API latency and database queries.
* Debug complex issues across the entire stack rather than stopping at service boundaries.
* Write maintainable, well\-tested code and raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews.
* Identify technical debt and proactively improve architecture, developer experience, observability, and engineering productivity.
* Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions.
* Take ownership of features in production and work with the team to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.
* Participate actively in engineering design discussions and influence how Rocketlane's technology evolves.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------


### **Frontend**


You are comfortable with:


* React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
* SPA architecture and component design
* HTML and CSS
* State management and complex client\-side application flows
* Browser fundamentals such as caching, storage, networking, and rendering
* Building reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture
* Frontend performance profiling and optimization
* Building responsive and high\-quality product experiences

Experience with real\-time applications, WebSockets, large data\-heavy interfaces, rich editors, or spreadsheet\-like experiences is a plus.


### **Backend**


You have strong fundamentals in:


* Java and Spring or similar backend frameworks
* HTTP and REST API design
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* Data modelling and query performance
* Redis and caching
* Asynchronous processing and message brokers
* Designing scalable and resilient backend services
* Performance optimization
* Debugging and root\-cause analysis
* Logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting

### **Engineering fundamentals**


Beyond knowing frameworks, we expect you to understand **why systems behave the way they do**.


You should be comfortable discussing topics such as:


* API and system design
* Database transactions and concurrency
* Caching strategies
* Distributed systems fundamentals
* Failure handling and resiliency
* Performance and scalability
* Security and authorization
* Testing strategy
* Production observability
* Clean code and maintainable architecture

**What we're really looking for**
---------------------------------


We're **not looking for someone who is 50% frontend and 50% backend but shallow in both**.


We're looking for an engineer who has strong depth in at least one part of the stack, solid engineering fundamentals across the other, and the ability to independently take a customer problem from:


**Problem Design Architecture Backend Frontend Production**


You should be someone who asks:


“What is the right solution for the customer and the product?”


rather than:


“Is this a frontend problem or a backend problem?”


**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------


* You enjoy owning problems rather than just completing tickets.
* You care about both **how a product works and how it feels to use**.
* You can move quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.
* You are comfortable working through ambiguity and breaking large problems into smaller ones.
* You enjoy collaborating directly with Product and Design.
* You are willing to dive into unfamiliar parts of the stack when the problem requires it.
* You care about performance, reliability, and maintainability — not just getting something to work.
* You enjoy mentoring other engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on.
* You like learning, experimenting, and continuously improving the way software is built.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience building B2B SaaS products
* Experience in a startup or high\-growth product company
* AWS experience
* Docker/containerization experience
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience building real\-time collaborative applications
* Experience with WebSockets
* Experience working with high\-volume APIs or large datasets
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks
* Experience designing enterprise\-grade integrations
* Exposure to AI\-assisted product development or AI\-powered product experiences

**Why Rocketlane?**
-------------------


### **Build challenging product experiences**


You'll work on problems that go well beyond basic CRUD applications — collaborative workflows, highly interactive interfaces, automation, data\-heavy experiences, enterprise integrations, and increasingly AI\-powered experiences.


### **Own meaningful parts of the product**


Engineers at Rocketlane are expected to understand the problem, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from how customers use it.


### **Work across boundaries**


You won't be constrained by artificial frontend/backend boundaries. If solving the problem requires changing the UI, API, data model, cache, or infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to work across all of them.


### **Raise your engineering bar**


You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about building a world\-class SaaS product.


And most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to look at something customers use every day and say:


**“I built that.”**

title: Junior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for highly motivated and technically curious developers who can build **web and mobile applications using modern development practices and AI\-assisted coding tools**.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy solving problems, experimenting with new technologies, and using AI tools to accelerate software development.

We are **not looking only for someone who can write code**. We are looking for people who can **understand a problem, analyze requirements, think logically, design a solution, use AI effectively, validate the generated code, debug issues, and deliver a working application end\-to\-end**.

Freshers with strong technical fundamentals, personal projects, GitHub projects, internships, hackathon experience, or demonstrated AI\-assisted development skills are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

You will be responsible for:

* Building complete **web and mobile applications** from requirements to deployment.
* Using AI coding tools effectively for **vibe coding / AI\-assisted software development**.
* Converting business requirements and ideas into functional applications.
* Breaking complex problems into smaller, manageable engineering tasks.
* Designing frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and application workflows.
* Developing responsive and user\-friendly web applications.
* Developing cross\-platform and/or native mobile applications.
* Integrating REST APIs, third\-party services, authentication systems, databases, notifications, payments, analytics, and other application services.
* Reading, understanding, reviewing, and improving AI\-generated code.
* Debugging application issues systematically rather than depending entirely on AI\-generated solutions.

* Using Git and following proper source\-control practices.

* Understanding existing codebases and making changes without breaking existing functionality.

* Taking ownership of features throughout the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**.

Core Skills We Are Looking For Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

Candidates should have strong:

* Analytical thinking
* Logical thinking
* Reasoning ability
* Problem\-solving skills
* Debugging skills
* Root\-cause analysis
* Attention to detail
* Ability to understand complex requirements
* Ability to break a problem into smaller technical components
* Ability to evaluate multiple solutions and choose an appropriate approach

Candidates should be comfortable using modern AI tools for software development, such as:

* ChatGPT

* Codex
* Cursor

* Requirement analysis

* Documentation

* HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* TypeScript
* React / Next.js / Angular / Vue or similar frameworks
* Responsive web development
* Client\-server architecture
* State management

**Mobile Development**

* React Native / Flutter or similar cross\-platform frameworks
* Basic understanding of Android and iOS application development
* Mobile application lifecycle
* API integration
* Push notifications
* App permissions and device capabilities

**Backend Development**

* Node.js / Python / Java / .NET or equivalent backend technology
* REST APIs
* Authentication and authorization
* API design
* Error handling
* Background processing
* Third\-party API integrations

**Database**

* SQL fundamentals
* MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQL Server
* NoSQL databases such as MongoDB / Firebase
* Database design and relationships
* Basic query optimization

Software Engineering Fundamentals

Candidates should understand:

* **SDLC – Software Development Life Cycle**
* Requirement gathering and analysis
* System design
* Development
* Testing
* Deployment
* Maintenance
* Agile / Scrum fundamentals
* Git and version control
* Branching and pull requests
* API design
* Database design
* Authentication and authorization
* Application security basics
* Error handling and logging
* Unit and integration testing
* CI/CD basics
* Cloud and deployment fundamentals
* Performance and scalability fundamentals

What Makes a Strong Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Can take an idea and turn it into a working application.
* Learn new technologies quickly.
* Are comfortable working with unfamiliar frameworks or codebases.
* Have strong curiosity and continuously experiment with new technologies.
* Can use AI to significantly improve development speed without compromising quality.
* Understand **why the code works**, not just how to generate it.
* Can identify when an AI\-generated solution is incorrect, insecure, inefficient, or unnecessarily complicated.
* Can debug problems independently.
* Ask the right questions when requirements are unclear.
* Take ownership rather than waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.

Qualification

* B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc Computer Science / IT or equivalent qualification preferred.
* **Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are welcome.**
* Strong skills and demonstrated ability are more important than years of experience.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds with strong development skills and projects are also encouraged to apply.

Added Advantage

Extra consideration will be given to candidates with:

* Live web or mobile applications
* GitHub portfolio
* Personal or college projects
* Internship experience
* Hackathon participation
* Open\-source contributions
* Experience deploying applications to cloud platforms
* Published Android/iOS applications
* Experience building applications using AI coding agents
* Experience with AWS / Azure / GCP / Firebase / Supabase

What We Value

**Think → Analyze → Plan → Build → Test → Debug → Improve → Deliver**

We want developers who combine **human reasoning \+ strong engineering fundamentals \+ AI\-assisted development**.

AI should make you faster — but your **analytical ability, logical thinking, engineering judgment, and problem\-solving skills** should make the software reliable.

If you are passionate about building products, enjoy solving difficult problems, and believe AI is changing how modern software is developed, we would like to hear from you.

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Job Summary  

  

NCR VOYIX Corporation is seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer (I) to join our innovative team. This entry\-level position will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of cutting\-edge software solutions within a collaborative and dynamic environment.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
* Use AI to Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code in accordance with established coding standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements and contribute to technical discussions.
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving software defects and issues.
* Develop and execute unit tests and participate in integration and system testing.
* Learn and apply new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to project needs.
* Contribute to code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Maintain and improve existing software applications.

* Familiarity with software development tools and methodologies (e.g., version control systems like GitHub, GitHub Actions, Agile development).
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.

* Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
